title: Engineering rules
summary: How Tally is built, where it is decided and has to hold.
description: A React and TypeScript frontend in a Tauri shell, with SQLite run from Rust. The rules here hold across the whole code base.

requirements.text: The frontend is React and TypeScript in a Tauri 2 shell; SQLite runs in Rust and the frontend queries it through drizzle.
`bun run build` typechecks `src/`, lints everything and bundles, and fails on any type or lint error.

history.text: `bun run build` typechecks, lints and bundles, and fails on any lint error.
history.reason: Version 1 didn't match the product: tests and scripts are linted but not typechecked.

requirements.text: CI builds the Android and macOS apps and checks sync triggers against SQLite 3.39; it does not run the test suite.
